description.text: The discipline of Circuits and Systems started its master program in 2003. Based on the theory of modern circuits and systems, it focuses on the research in circuit and system design, development, application, manufacture in the area of electronic information and communications, and trains specialized talents with a solid theoretical and technical basis of electronic circuits, signal processing, modern information and communication network, and with competency for scientific research concerned, technology development, education and management in research institutes, industrial sectors or higher educational institutions. The discipline is equipped with a highly cooperative and competent faculty, and a rationally- structured academic echelon consisting of professors / researchers, associate professors and lecturers with strong research and teaching forces and strong academic atmosphere (2 doctors). At present a number of projects are being carried out, including the National Natural Science Fund, the provincial, ministerial and national, key scientific research projects; It has won a number of provincial- and ministerial scientific and technological awards; It has published two academic books and about 200 papers in domestic and international academic journals or on international academic conferences, including "IEEE International Journal of Bifurcation and Chaos", "Electronics Letters", "Chinese Physics", "physics", and "electronic journals", "Computational Physics" and other core journals at home or abroad.

duration.text: The Circuit and System at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 6 or above
